_note: The world manifest. Spaces are playable geometry (content/spaces/). PLACES ARE NOT AUTHORED HERE: content/places.json is written by CAMT's publish job from the archive registry (only publication: public entities), so a place in the game is always a real registry entity and nobody authors locations twice (owner ruling 2026-09-03). `bindings` is the join: which Space represents which Place, by registry slug. A Space with no binding is fiction and is labelled so. Each neighborhood carries `timezone` (IANA) so the game's clock reads the place's own time. `bindings[].era` is RESERVED for the time-travel layer (owner, 2026-09-03: versions of the same place in different periods, as in Chrono Trigger): one place, several spaces, one per era; unset means the present.
